_comment: Scales students use to prioritize their patients. settings.priorityScale picks one. The instructor hasn't chosen a triage system yet (SPEC §14); add another scale here as data only. type 'levels': each patient gets one level; each level lists the instructor tags it matches (used by the debrief and the priority-mismatch rule). 'tone' picks a display color (red, yellow, green, black, neutral). Each level (and each instructor tag under instructorTags) has a symbol so tags never rely on color alone.

levels.label: Red
levels.description: Immediate: unstable or at risk of rapid decline

levels.label: Yellow
levels.description: Urgent: needs care soon, currently stable

instructorTags._comment: How the instructor's triage tags display: a shape as well as color and name (color-blind safe).
